in_english.name: Marufirah
in_english.long_meaning: Marufirah is a name that signifies good character and behavior, derived from the Arabic root 'maruf', which means good, virtuous, or righteous. In Islamic tradition, a person with good character is considered to be close to Allah, just like the prophets, truthful ones, martyrs, and righteous individuals. The Quran emphasizes the importance of good character and behavior, stating that those who follow Allah and His Messenger will be with those whom Allah has blessed with prophethood, truthfulness, martyrdom, and righteousness.
